'''Synred Vols''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], Synred Vols was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], achieving the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Stationed on [[Almas]] at the [[Almas Academy|experimental academy]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Master Vols selected the young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Hary'nkel]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and they patrolled the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] together during their [[Time/Legends|time]] together.<ref name="DC" />

During the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Master [[Kirlocca]] organized an expedition into the [[Almas Wasteland|wastelands of Almas]], in which Master Vols and Padawan Hary'nkel participated. While making camp, the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that permeated the wastes affected Jedi [[Syr Tal-Soten]], [[Trevon Rey]] and [[Seeth'tal]], all of whom attacked their fellow Jedi. During the confusion of the assault, Masters Vols, [[Misha Quor-Din]] and another Jedi moved to protect Kirlocca and the other Padawans but they too were attacked by the deranged Jedi. During the fighting, Master Vols was killed, sacrificing himself so that Masters Kirlocca, Quor-Din, his Padawan and the others could escape.<ref name="DC" />
